one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.23847）：Behavioral Couplings 明确点出 'Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. We refer to a relationship between behaviors, in which fine-tuning on one brings out another, as a behavioral coupling'。是 llm-evaluation × security-governance × ai-agent 的 'unintended-behavior coupling / alignment side-effect' 趋势资产——'把 fine-tune 引发的副作用形式化为 coupling' 是 alignment 评测路线的近期方向。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7-14 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看耦合度量协议 / 跨模型族鲁棒性。
